data.description: The data a document's placeholders read, as given: a path, or `-` (left out without).

input.description: The input as given: a path, or `-` (standard input, or inline under MCP).

output.description: Where the PDF went: a path, or `-`.

profiles.description: The profiles the PDF meets, as their usual names (`PDF/UA-1`).

tagged.description: Whether the PDF is tagged (the flow tags every document).

warnings.description:
What the PDF leaves out or works around: raw HTML (`markdown-html-ignored`); images that
are remote, outside the Markdown's folder or missing (`markdown-image-missing`); and
keep-together rules it had to break.
